meta.notes: Cut from the Protomaps planet build 20261112.pmtiles, with OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-11-12T04:00:00Z. Tiles are whole: they include map data past the county line. meta.title: Aerial imagery

sources.name: USDA NAIP 2025, flown 2025-07-05 to 2025-09-14
sources.credit: Imagery: USDA NAIP 2025. USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center.

sources.name: USDA NAIP 2023, flown 2023-08-11 to 2023-08-24
sources.credit: Imagery: USDA NAIP 2023. USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center.

meta.notes: Summer, leaf-on imagery, built from the 1.2 m level of each NAIP image, so it is less sharp than NAIP's full detail. Clipped to the county outline plus about 300 m and transparent beyond it. Where the newest year (2025) has no image, 2023 imagery fills in, so colors and season can change at those edges.

sources.name: Champaign County Regional Planning Commission, Champaign County Greenways
sources.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
sources.credit: Champaign County Regional Planning Commission, Champaign County Greenways, ODbL

meta.notes: 'open' means open to the public on foot. It does not mean open to hunting: whether hunting is allowed is not in this layer. Boundaries are approximate and are not a legal survey. Left out: easements on private land that are closed to the public, planning boundaries such as military or proposed areas, and easement records that repeat a fee record. Champaign County Forest Preserve District land is drawn from the regional planning commission's open spaces, because PAD-US is out of date there. This archive combines public domain and ODbL data and is offered under the ODbL 1.0.
